title: EventEnvelope
description: Common contract (metadata) of every event and command that travels through EventBridge, SNS and SQS. Business data goes in 'payload'; each <Name>.v<n>.schema.json constrains eventType, schemaVersion, kind, producer and payload. Fields are exactly those of the EventEnvelope record of the event-contracts library.
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.2 (EventEnvelope record and governance rules); ADR-021 decision 2; DISENO 7.2 (traceparent and correlationId in envelope and message attributes). dataClass is NOT an envelope field: each schema declares it (annotation x-dataClass). Sequence numbers (templateSeq, engagementSeq) are payload fields per the catalog (DISENO 4.3), not envelope fields.

eventId.description: Universal idempotency key (INV-07). Consumers deduplicate by it. For DynamoDB CDC relays it is deterministic (hash of PK + version, ADR-019), expressed as a name-based UUID v5 of PK + version (DISENO 4.7).

eventType.description: Message name without version suffix, e.g. 'VersionGraphNodeAdded'. Past-tense fact for events, imperative verb for commands. Also the SNS/SQS 'eventType' message attribute and the EventBridge detail-type.

schemaVersion.description: Major contract version (1 for v1). The record rejects values < 1.

occurredAt.description: Instant of the fact at the producer (ISO-8601, UTC).

producer.description: Producing service: one of the seven ms-* services or an existing system's hook (templates-service, engagements-system) (DISENO 4.1, DEC-22). There are no operator or pipeline producers.

correlationId.description: Propagated from the request or the original publish; the root correlationId of a publish is its publishId (DISENO 7.2). Typed String in the record, so not constrained to uuid.

causationId.description: eventId of the message that caused this one; null in root hooks (Templates Service / Engagement System) and in messages whose cause is not a message (an API call or a scheduler); correlationId still links them to the request or run.

cellId.description: Cell where the message was produced: 'global' for the home region or a regional cell id (example values, configurable).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent (version-traceid-parentid-flags); also sent as message attribute (RNF-017).

payload.description: Business data; constrained by each message schema. Never workpaper content; bounded by S_payload (blobs by claim-check in S3).

uuid.description: Identifier (UUID), as in the DynamoDB/PostgreSQL schemas.

versionLabel.description: Template version label issued by the Templates Service (natural key, not a uuid), e.g. 'v7'.

dataClass.description: Residency classification declared by every message schema (x-dataClass). Only TEMPLATE_PUBLIC may cross regions.

priorityClass.description: PriorityClass of ms-publish-fanout (same values as FanOutJob.priority / FanOutTask.priority).
